searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "SimCLR" from February 2020, which simplifies contrastive learning, and "Idefics2" from April 2024, which improves OCR capabilities. From Morgan Stanley, notable papers include "Rethinking Langevin Thompson Sampling" and "Average-Case Hardness of Parity Problems." The paper "Small Language Models are the Future" from 2025 argues for the potential of smaller language models in agentic AI. Additionally, the Transformer model introduced in "Attention Is All You Need" remains a foundational paper in the field.
